DOORWAY WIDE: from the doorway at eye level, the room spreads fully left and right, the window anchoring the far wall
DOORWAY CENTERED: eye level from the doorway threshold, the room recedes in soft perspective, the window glowing at its heart
DOORWAY LOW-EYE: eye level from the doorway, the room floor leads the eye forward, the window sitting bright and central beyond
DOORWAY WARM: from the doorway at eye level, warm interior light fills the room, the window a luminous rectangle ahead
DOORWAY STEADY: eye level at the doorway, the room holds its full depth, the window drawing light across the far wall

WINDOW SIDE SEATED: at seated height beside the window, the room stretches away, the window glowing close at the frame's edge
SEATED SILL HEIGHT: seated beside the window at sill height, the room recedes gently, the window flooding the frame with outside light
WINDOW COMPANION: seated height just beside the window, the room fans out across the frame, the window tall and bright alongside
SETTLED BESIDE: at seated height beside the window, the room's full interior spreads, the window and its light close and radiant
CORNER THREE-QUARTER: from a corner, two walls meeting at the window, the furniture stepping back in depth

CORNER DIAGONAL: from the corner, two walls sweep diagonally, the window centred between them, the whole room visible in depth
CORNER ANGLE: three-quarter from the corner, two walls and their details visible, the window bright at the far intersection
CORNER FULL: a corner vantage takes in two full walls, the room entire between them, the window glowing at the far end

FLOOR LEVEL GLOW: from the floor looking across the rug, the room opens upward and away, the window luminous above the far baseboard
LOW FLOOR SWEEP: low to the floor, the rug fills the foreground, the room lifts overhead, the window shining at the far wall
RUG TO WINDOW: from floor height, the rug leads the eye across the room, the window set tall and bright beyond
FROM THE FAR WALL: from the far wall looking toward the window, the room extends ahead, the window filling the opposite wall with light
FAR WALL GAZE: from the far wall, the whole room lies between, the window on the opposite wall glowing softly
FAR WALL DEPTH: from the far wall, the room recedes in full view, the window ahead centred and radiant on the opposite side
FAR WALL EXPANSE: at the far wall looking across the room, the full interior spreads open, the window bright and welcoming opposite
FAR WALL PROSPECT: from the far wall, the room stretches its full length, the window opposite filled with soft outside luminance
